Text-to-Speech

BoobaStudio's Text-to-Speech (TTS) feature generates spoken audio from text using AI voices. Create narration, ambient dialogue, or character voices that play directly in Foundry VTT for all connected players.

Overview

TTS uses ElevenLabs AI voice technology to convert text into high-quality speech audio. You can choose from hundreds of voices, adjust voice settings, and generate audio clips that enhance your game sessions.

How It Works

  • Open the TTS Tool — from the BoobaStudio menu or sound generator
  • Choose a Voice — browse and preview available voices
  • Enter Text — type or paste the text you want spoken
  • Generate — the AI converts text to speech
  • Playback — the audio plays for all connected players

Accessing TTS

From the BoobaStudio menu

  • Open the BoobaStudio radial menu
  • Navigate to the sound/TTS section
  • The TTS panel opens ready for input

From the Sound Generator

  • Open the Sound Generator ( icon in the BoobaStudio menu)
  • Switch to the TTS tab
  • Configure voice and text

From the Welcome Screen

  • Open the BoobaStudio welcome screen
  • Click the Text-to-Speech card

Voice Selection

Browsing Voices

Voices are organized by category:

  • Male/Female — filter by gender
  • Fantasy/Sci-Fi — genre-appropriate voices
  • Narration/Character — style of delivery
  • Language — filter by spoken language

Voice Preview

Click the play button next to any voice to hear a preview sample before selecting it.

Voice Settings

Fine-tune your selected voice:

  • Stability — higher values produce more consistent delivery, lower values add variation
  • Similarity — how closely the output matches the original voice profile

Favorites

Mark frequently used voices as favorites () for quick access. Favorites appear at the top of the voice browser.

Voice Comparison

Select multiple voices and use the Compare feature to hear them side-by-side with the same text. This helps you find the perfect voice for each character.

TTS Models

Different ElevenLabs models offer varying quality and speed:

  • Multilingual V2 — best quality, supports many languages
  • Turbo V2.5 — faster generation with good quality
  • Flash V2.5 — fastest, good for real-time narration
  • V3 — latest model with improved expressiveness

Tips

  • Keep text short — 1-3 sentences generates faster and sounds more natural
  • Use punctuation — commas and periods control pacing and pauses
  • Match voice to character — assign consistent voices to recurring NPCs
  • Combine with Speaking Tokens — configure voices directly on tokens for in-character speech
  • Preview before playing — generate and listen before broadcasting to all players

Requirements

  • BoobaStudio module installed and configured
  • A configured narration (TTS) provider
  • Credit with your configured provider
